desc:
🌿 Build your own mysterious anomaly garden!
👥 Visitors will come to explore your garden.
🪴 Place creepy plants to lure, trap, and catch visitors.
🧠 Combine anomalous plants to create powerful combos and earn more Cash!
⭐️ Collect unique buildings and rare plants to expand your garden.
🔍 Explore your garden or visit someone else’s to discover strange anomalies!

✅ Your garden keeps earning Cash even while you’re offline! ✅
